knowledge: K=ordinary-school-knowledge-v1. Both roles use exactly the same scope of knowledge: ordinary language, logic, arithmetic, and general scientific knowledge from the usual middle-school curriculum, common object categories and definitions of common terms are allowed. Allowed examples are the laws of magnetic poles, the difference between gases and light, ordinary rock classification and the format of scientific names; a proof is not rejected because such general facts are not written verbatim in the material. Material-specific numbers, experimental settings, people's possessions, the strength of objects, unmarked scales or relations that are not given must not be used. Identical appearance or icons do not prove identical physical strength. Specialised memory such as the exact Latin-name correspondence of a rare species or the year of a specific event does not belong to K by default; if a solution depends crucially on such memory and Q and the retained material do not support it, mark it undecided. It is not allowed to covertly use the original missing modality, dataset answers or memorised example questions. K is a pre-frozen operational knowledge convention, not an assertion about everyone's commonsense ability.
